name: Brass Motel Key 14
qc_notes: Must read as old brass, not shiny gold
inspect_text: Room 14. The number is worn soft, but legible.

name: Locket Tintype
inspect_text: A tintype locket. The two faces inside don't always agree on who was happy.

name: Tape 03
qc_notes: Reads as worn consumer cassette; playback rewrites room state
inspect_text: Tape 03. Play it and the room edits itself behind you.

name: Bathroom Mirror
qc_notes: Reflection lag must read clearly — no cheap jump scare
inspect_text: The reflection answers late. Your eyes are open; the reflected ones aren't.

name: The Black Device
qc_notes: Purposeful, never explained outright. No sci-fi UI gloss
inspect_text: Cold to the touch, warm where it shouldn't be. It is listening.
